question: Explain the concept of caching and when to use it.
intendedUser: Professional in Track-A with early-career experience
description: Technical interview question for Track-A professionals.
exampleAnswer: Caching stores frequently accessed data in fast storage. I implemented Redis caching for user sessions and database query results. Use caching when data is read-heavy, changes infrequently, or computation is expensive. Avoid caching when data must be real-time or consistency is critical.
